constraints: Investigate negative evidence and branch/deployment applicability
instructions: Freshly research all 13 CSV repositories, PRs, issues, discussions and primary literature for useful H200 deployment improvements. Reopen B200 exclusions; do not use B200 ranking as selection prior. Known flags, ports, kernels, topology, routing and negative results welcome; novelty not required. Separate source claim, source fix and our transfer hypothesis. Every candidate needs concrete baseline delta, strongest simple comparator, activation signal and denominator, competing explanations, scoped correctness, held-out test, and support/reject/inconclusive decisions. Select a diverse, practical shortlist; do not invent gains or assume API endpoints establish kernel dispatch. GPU experiments and server modifications are outside this research run.

focus: DeepGEMM #452 is a separate contiguous prefill MQA epilogue optimization, not the paged candidate-only decode patches. The live header still uses fmaxf and unhalved KV scales. Compare source-author H200 microbenchmarks against actual invocation/shape and exposed prefill time. The source claim that x+abs(x)=2relu(x) is exact for all finite float32 is too broad: finite x can overflow when doubled, and NaN behavior differs; require range/scaling/reference and top-k-set checks. H200 serving gain unmeasured. Prefer the smallest reversible JIT-header integration and a cold-prefill versus warm-cache discriminator.
